title: What is the NeeDoh Lava Lamp? The $30 toy reselling for $250
answer: The NeeDoh Lava Lamp is a Target-exclusive, roughly 14.5-inch lava lamp from Schylling, the maker of NeeDoh squishy toys. It has a soft base you squeeze to move the gel inside, costs $30 and comes with a mini squishy. It sold out within about a day of its Nov. 8, 2026 launch and now resells online for $250 or more.
body:
NeeDoh is a line of squeezable stress toys made by Schylling, a Massachusetts toy company. The first one, a round ball called the Groovy Glob, came out in 2017; the line now has more than 50 styles, including the popular Nice Cube. Squeeze videos, "NeeDoh hunting" trips to stores and collection hauls turned the toys into one of the biggest TikTok crazes of 2026, and Schylling's CEO has said the company sold through its entire 2026 inventory in the first nine weeks of the year.

The lava lamp is the newest and hardest-to-find piece. It comes in blue or pink, is sold only in Target stores (not on Target.com) and includes one of three exclusive mini NeeDohs. It went on shelves Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026, and most stores ran out within about a day. Shoppers report that some stores keep it behind the customer service desk, and resale sites say sealed lamps have sold for $250 to $300 on eBay, with some listings asking more.

The scramble is part of a wider holiday rush: a Nov. 23 New York Post report called NeeDoh this year's hottest Christmas toy, with resellers charging several times the $4 to $7 retail price for common models. Schylling has also warned about counterfeits on sites like Temu and eBay and recommends buying from authorized stores.

For parents: NeeDohs are made to be squeezed at room temperature. Schylling warns never to heat, microwave or freeze them, and fire officials have reported children burned after microwaved toys burst, a stunt that circulated on social media. If a toy tears or leaks, throw it away.
in_the_news: Target's $30 NeeDoh Lava Lamp sold out days after its Nov. 8, 2026 launch and is reselling for $250 or more as NeeDoh becomes the season's must-have toy.

faq.q: Where can I buy the NeeDoh Lava Lamp?
faq.a: It is a Target in-store exclusive and is not sold on Target.com. Stock varies by store, so shoppers often ask staff to check by item number.

faq.q: How much is the NeeDoh Lava Lamp?
faq.a: $30 at Target. Sealed lamps have resold for about $250 to $300 on eBay.

faq.q: Is it safe to microwave a NeeDoh?
faq.a: No. Schylling says never to heat, microwave or freeze NeeDohs; heated gel can burst and cause burns.
